messages:
Eloise: starting canary v2.7.0 -> eu-central, initial 6% across rerank+embeds. deploy-bot: rollout 6450 started at 1787654322 (routes=rerank,embeds,traffic=6%)

SLO-alert-bot: [WARN] rerank eu-central p95 increased from 210ms -> 470ms (threshold 350ms) 

Marco: seeing p95 jump and a small 5xx blip to 0.45% (alert at 0.4%). Link: https://console.redwood/slo/rerank-route/eu-central

eng-sre: logs show model-serve worker serialization delays on host ms-eu-12; rpc retry queue length climbed. snippet: `2026-03-26T10:18:03Z warn: rpc-queue=78 host=ms-eu-12`

Eloise: is this a localized host issue or an artifact of v2.7.0? Any correlation with new batching heuristics?

Marco: quick diff shows v2.7.0 bumped preemptive-batch-size default from 8->12 for rerank. Could be causing queueing on smaller hosts.

Eloise: decision options: (A) full rollback; (B) pin rerank in eu-central to v2.6.4; (C) target split traffic to larger hosts and keep canary elsewhere. Prefer B to minimize blast radius. Thoughts?

eng-sre: agree with B. We can pin the rerank route in eu-central while leaving embeds and other regions alone. Run pin and pause for rerank eu-central.

Marco: executing: `deployctl pause --rollout=6450 --route=rerank --region=eu-central` -> success at 1787654378

Marco: executing: `deployctl pin --route=rerank --region=eu-central --version=v2.6.4 --reason='p95-spike-canary'` -> pin success at 1787654386. rerank eu-central traffic reverted.

deploy-bot: paused rerank rollout and pinned route to v2.6.4. embeds remains on v2.7.0 at 6%

SLO-alert-bot: [INFO] rerank p95 back near baseline after pin. 5xx returned to 0.12%

Eloise: nice. eng-sre, can you collect rpc-queue histograms and post traces for ms-eu-12 so eng-runtime can tune batching heuristics?

eng-sre: uploaded traces & histograms: https://s3.redwood/6450/ms-eu-12-queue-hist.tar.gz. preliminary: small-host CPU saturation + larger preemptive batches created queue head-of-line delays.

Eloise: release-notes-bot, add note: "Pinned rerank in eu-central to v2.6.4 after p95 spike during canary; embeds canary continues; investigating batching defaults and host sizing."

release-notes-bot: PR updated https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/401 at 1787654410

Marco: next steps: eng-runtime to propose one of (1) revert preemptive-batch default to 8, (2) make batch-size adaptive by host capacity, or (3) schedule canary on larger host slices. We'll iterate.

Eloise: timeline: hold rerank pin until a validated fix is smoke-tested for 20m. If fix validated, we re-roll rerank in eu-central with a smaller batch flag. If not, we'll keep pin and consider full rollback.

eng-sre: adding eng-runtime + eng-ml to incident channel and creating INC-6450 for RCA.

Eloise: thanks all. Closing thread until updates; anyone can re-open with new signals. :thumbsup:
